Started single qlean node first to generate chain of blocks, then started zeam node to sync these blocks. Couldn't test that scenario with ream ("Expected Ream to be started before genesis time"). Zeam requested head block, but couldn't import it ("error.MissingPreState"), maybe it didn't request parent block before importing. Also found two inconsistencies between zeam/ream implementations and spec. 1. zeam (https://github.com/blockblaz/zeam/blob/03e19111c28cc134482351940537d93b296bd444/rust/libp2p-glue/src/req_resp/inbound_protocol.rs#L76-L92) and ream (https://github.com/ReamLabs/ream/blob/f8f1a8b0ac6d1c3b9a2b7d97f6173adba0550aa2/crates/networking/p2p/src/req_resp/inbound_protocol.rs#L133-L139) request-response protocols expect extra "response status" byte before varint prefixed response frame. Couldn't find "response status" in spec. 2. according to spec (https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanSpec/blob/5eb470832733e26087c633081b51f875fc4c7102/src/lean_spec/subspecs/networking/reqresp/message.py#L80-L83) block request protocol response contains list of blocks, but in zeam (https://github.com/blockblaz/zeam/blob/03e19111c28cc134482351940537d93b296bd444/pkgs/network/src/interface.zig#L346-L347) and ream (https://github.com/ReamLabs/ream/blob/f8f1a8b0ac6d1c3b9a2b7d97f6173adba0550aa2/crates/networking/p2p/src/req_resp/lean/messages/mod.rs#L39-L41) response is single block. Started single qlean node first to generate chain of blocks, then started zeam node to sync these blocks. Couldn't test that scenario with ream ("Expected Ream to be started before genesis time"). Couldn't find "response status" in spec. 2. according to spec block request protocol response contains list of blocks, but in zeam and ream response is single block. What is expected response type? I looked into this and yes, zeam and ream prepend a 1-byte status code to responses zeam/ream: [status_u8][varint_length][ssz_snappy_payload] qlean-mini: [varint_length][ssz_snappy_payload] the spec does not define a response status byte I think we copied this from Ethereum Beacon Chain also, the term response_chunk is never defined in the spec zeam/qlean are wire-incompatible right now.

<turuslan> re: **@salakhiev**
> Syncing works for qlean<->qlean networks, but we couldn't verify it is compatibility with other clients yet
Tried syncing zeam node from qlean node (qlean branch (https://github.com/qdrvm/qlean-mini/pull/50)).

Started single qlean node first to generate chain of blocks,
then started zeam node to sync these blocks.

Couldn't test that scenario with ream ("Expected Ream to be started before genesis time").

Zeam requested head block,
but couldn't import it ("error.MissingPreState"),
maybe it didn't request parent block before importing.



Also found two inconsistencies between zeam/ream implementations and spec.

1. zeam (https://github.com/blockblaz/zeam/blob/03e19111c28cc134482351940537d93b296bd444/rust/libp2p-glue/src/req_resp/inbound_protocol.rs#L76-L92) and ream (https://github.com/ReamLabs/ream/blob/f8f1a8b0ac6d1c3b9a2b7d97f6173adba0550aa2/crates/networking/p2p/src/req_resp/inbound_protocol.rs#L133-L139) request-response protocols expect extra "response status" byte before varint prefixed response frame.
Couldn't find "response status" in spec.

2. according to spec (https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanSpec/blob/5eb470832733e26087c633081b51f875fc4c7102/src/lean_spec/subspecs/networking/reqresp/message.py#L80-L83) block request protocol response contains list of blocks,
but in zeam (https://github.com/blockblaz/zeam/blob/03e19111c28cc134482351940537d93b296bd444/pkgs/network/src/interface.zig#L346-L347) and ream (https://github.com/ReamLabs/ream/blob/f8f1a8b0ac6d1c3b9a2b7d97f6173adba0550aa2/crates/networking/p2p/src/req_resp/lean/messages/mod.rs#L39-L41) response is single block.
What is expected response type?
